name: Day 11 — 家與遠方 Home & Far Away

readings.title: 跟媽媽視訊 Video Call with Mom

qs.q: When does the video call happen?
What is mom's first question?
How does he feel after the call?

gram.d: Casual done-yet question: 吃飽了沒？ eaten yet? 到了沒？ there yet? A clipped, warm version of 了嗎 — the register of moms everywhere.

qs.q: What big news does he share?
What is mom's advice?
What photos does he send?

gram.d: 傳 = to send/transmit (digitally): 傳照片給她 send her photos, 傳訊息給我 text me. The messaging-era verb — 寄 is for physical mail, 傳 for everything on a screen.

readings.title: 寄包裹回美國 Shipping a Box Home

qs.q: What's in the package?
ch: Pineapple cakes, tea, and small gifts

qs.q: Why choose air freight?
ch: Food would spoil on the two-month sea route

qs.q: What are the two final steps?
ch: Fill in the form and stick on a fragile label

gram.t: A 比較 X，B 比較 Y
gram.d: The trade-off frame: 空運比較快，海運比較便宜 — air is faster, sea is cheaper. Two 比較 clauses side by side lay out any decision; finish it with 我選… and you've reasoned aloud in Mandarin.

readings.title: 合約審查 The Contract Review

qs.q: What must happen before the signing?
What commitment is now written into the contract?
What one revision is needed?

gram.d: 寫清楚 = write it clearly — verb + 清楚 as a result: 說清楚 explain clearly, 想清楚 think it through, 罰則要寫清楚 the penalties must be spelled out. Contract language lives on this complement.

readings.title: 少子化的挑戰 The Birthrate Challenge

qs.q: Where does Taiwan's birth rate rank?
What double squeeze does the passage describe?
What do experts identify as the root causes?
ch: Housing prices, wages, and working hours

gram.d: 之一 = one of…: 生育率最低的國家之一 one of the lowest-birthrate countries. Formal hedge that keeps superlatives honest — news prose attaches it to nearly every 最.

dict.py: Nǐ chībǎo le méi?

dict.py: Wǒmen xīngqí tiān shìxùn ba!

qs.q: When is the video call planned?
What's the reminder?
ch: Call for dad's birthday next month

dict.py: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ guò de hěn hǎo.

dict.py: Wǒ chuán jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn gěi nǐ.

dict.zh: 台灣的朋友都很照顧我。
dict.py: Táiwān de péngyǒu dōu hěn zhàogù wǒ.
dict.en: My Taiwanese friends really look after me.

dict.py: Yǒu kòng wǒmen duō liáotiān.
dict.en: Let's chat more when we're free.

pass.zh: 媽，跟你報平安！這星期超順利：高雄的案子談成了，下個月簽約。我傳了照片給你，有夜市、有KTV。你們不用擔心我，台灣的同事都對我很好！

qs.q: What's the big report home?
ch: The Kaohsiung deal succeeded — signing next month

qs.q: What does he tell them not to do?

dict.py: Wǒ yào jì bāoguǒ dào Měiguó.
dict.en: I'd like to send a package to America.

dict.zh: 空運比較快，海運比較便宜。
dict.py: Kōngyùn bǐjiào kuài, hǎiyùn bǐjiào piányí.
dict.en: Air is faster; sea is cheaper.

dict.py: Lǐmiàn yǒu shíwù ma?

dict.py: Dàgài qī dào shí tiān huì dào.

pass.zh: 寄到美國的話，空運七到十天，一公斤四百五；海運要六到八個星期，一公斤一百五。裡面有食物要申報喔。要保值的話，可以加買保險。

qs.q: How long does sea freight take?
What must be declared?
What optional add-on is offered?

dict.py: Fǎwù kàn wán héyuē le.
dict.en: Legal has finished reviewing the contract.

dict.py: Yǒu yíge tiáokuǎn xūyào xiūgǎi.

dict.py: Yánchí jiāohuò de fázé yào xiě qīngchǔ.

dict.en: Send the new version to their side next week.

pass.zh: Eric，法務的意見出來了：整體沒大問題，二十四小時回覆的承諾也寫進去了。只有延遲交貨的罰則太模糊，要改成清楚的數字，對雙方才公平。你改好給我看一下，星期一寄給王先生。

qs.q: What's the overall legal verdict?
ch: Mostly fine — one clause too vague

qs.q: What must the penalty clause become?
ch: Clear numbers, fair to both parties

ch: Sending the revised version to Mr. Wang

dict.zh: 台灣的生育率是全世界最低之一。
dict.py: Táiwān de shēngyùlǜ shì quán shìjiè zuì dī zhīyī.
dict.en: Taiwan's birth rate is among the world's lowest.

dict.zh: 少子化讓許多學校招不到學生。
dict.py: Shǎozǐhuà ràng xǔduō xuéxiào zhāo bú dào xuéshēng.
dict.en: The birthrate decline leaves many schools unable to recruit students.

dict.zh: 高齡化的速度也在加快。
dict.py: Gāolínghuà de sùdù yě zài jiākuài.

dict.zh: 政府推出更多育兒補助。
dict.py: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū gèng duō yù'ér bǔzhù.
dict.en: The government rolled out more child-raising subsidies.

dict.zh: 專家指出，關鍵在住宅跟薪資。
dict.py: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, guānjiàn zài zhùzhái gēn xīnzī.
dict.en: Experts note the crux is housing and wages.

pass.zh: 社會新聞：統計指出，台灣生育率持續探底，少子化與高齡化同時進行，工作人口逐年減少，缺工問題更嚴重。政府加碼育兒補助與托育服務，但學者認為，住宅、薪資與工時的結構問題不解決，年輕人依然不敢生。

qs.q: What two trends are happening simultaneously?
What existing problem does the shrinking workforce worsen?
Why do scholars say subsidies alone fall short?
ch: Structural issues — housing, wages, hours — remain unsolved

scenarios.intro: The weekly ritual: answer the call, pass the eating inspection, give the tour, and dodge the when-are-you-coming-home question with love.

them.zh: 寶貝！終於接了！你好嗎？
them.py: Bǎobèi! Zhōngyú jiē le! Nǐ hǎo ma?
them.en: Sweetheart! Finally you picked up! How are you?

turns.task: Greet her warmly — you're great, and you miss them all.

ans.zh: 媽！我很好，我好想念你們！
ans.py: Mā! Wǒ hěn hǎo, wǒ hǎo xiǎngniàn nǐmen!
ans.en: Mom! I'm great — and I miss you all so much!

them.zh: 有沒有好好吃飯？不要每天吃外面！
them.py: Yǒu méiyǒu hǎohǎo chīfàn? Búyào měitiān chī wàimiàn!
them.en: Are you eating properly? Don't eat out every day!

turns.task: Reassure her: you eat very well — Taiwan's food is amazing, tell her not to worry.

ans.zh: 我吃得很好，台灣的東西超好吃！妳放心啦！
ans.py: Wǒ chī de hěn hǎo, Táiwān de dōngxi chāo hǎochī! Nǐ fàngxīn la!
ans.en: I'm eating great — Taiwan's food is incredible! Don't worry!

them.zh: 讓我看看你住的地方！
them.py: Ràng wǒ kànkan nǐ zhù de dìfāng!
them.en: Show me where you live!

turns.task: Give the camera tour: this is your room — small, but very comfortable.

ans.zh: 妳看，這是我的房間，小小的，可是很舒服。
ans.py: Nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ de fángjiān, xiǎoxiǎo de, kěshì hěn shūfú.
ans.en: Look — my room. Tiny, but really comfortable.

them.zh: 不錯不錯。那你什麼時候回來看我們？
them.py: Búcuò búcuò. Nà nǐ shénme shíhòu huílái kàn wǒmen?
them.en: Not bad! So when are you coming home to see us?

turns.task: The classic question — answer with love: maybe the holidays; and they should come visit Taiwan too!

ans.zh: 可能放假的時候回去。你們也要來台灣看我啊！
ans.py: Kěnéng fàngjià de shíhòu huíqù. Nǐmen yě yào lái Táiwān kàn wǒ a!
ans.en: Maybe over the holidays — and you all should come visit ME in Taiwan!

them.zh: 好好好，媽媽想去夜市！那先這樣，愛你喔！
them.py: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, māma xiǎng qù yèshì! Nà xiān zhèyàng, ài nǐ o!
them.en: Yes yes — mom wants the night market! Okay, that's all for now. Love you!

turns.task: Love you too — talk Sunday!

ans.zh: 我也愛你們！星期天再聊！
ans.py: Wǒ yě ài nǐmen! Xīngqí tiān zài liáo!
ans.en: Love you all too! Talk Sunday!

scenarios.intro: Your sister has questions about every photo you sent. Narrate Taiwan life, and negotiate her future visit — she has demands.

them.zh: 哥！你傳的照片也太好玩了吧！那個市場是什麼？
them.py: Gē! Nǐ chuán de zhàopiàn yě tài hǎowán le ba! Nàge shìchǎng shì shénme?
them.en: Bro! Your photos look SO fun! What's that market?

turns.task: Explain: that's a night market — tons of food, all delicious and super cheap.

ans.zh: 那是夜市！有很多小吃，又好吃又便宜！
ans.py: Nà shì yèshì! Yǒu hěnduō xiǎochī, yòu hǎochī yòu piányí!
ans.en: That's a night market — endless street food, delicious AND cheap!

them.zh: 我看到一杯飲料，裡面有黑黑的東西，那是什麼？
them.py: Wǒ kàndào yì bēi yǐnliào, lǐmiàn yǒu hēihēi de dōngxi, nà shì shénme?
them.en: I saw a drink with little black things in it — what IS that?

turns.task: Introduce the national treasure: bubble tea — the pearls are chewy and it's Taiwan's most famous drink.

ans.zh: 那是珍珠奶茶！珍珠QQ的，是台灣最有名的飲料！
ans.py: Nà shì zhēnzhū nǎichá! Zhēnzhū QQ de, shì Táiwān zuì yǒumíng de yǐnliào!
ans.en: Bubble tea! The pearls are perfectly chewy — Taiwan's most famous drink!

them.zh: 我要喝！我要去台灣找你！
them.py: Wǒ yào hē! Wǒ yào qù Táiwān zhǎo nǐ!
them.en: I want it! I'm coming to Taiwan to find you!

turns.task: Deal — when she visits, you'll take her to the night market every single day.

ans.zh: 好啊！妳來的話，我每天帶妳去逛夜市！
ans.py: Hǎo a! Nǐ lái dehuà, wǒ měitiān dài nǐ qù guàng yèshì!
ans.en: Deal! If you come, night market every single day!

them.zh: 說好了喔！對了，包裹裡有我的禮物嗎？
them.py: Shuō hǎo le o! Duìle, bāoguǒ lǐ yǒu wǒ de lǐwù ma?
them.en: Promise! Oh — is there a present for ME in the package?

turns.task: Tease her: it's a secret — she'll know when it arrives, in about a week.

ans.zh: 祕密！大概一個星期到，到了妳就知道了！
ans.py: Mìmì! Dàgài yíge xīngqí dào, dào le nǐ jiù zhīdào le!
ans.en: Secret! About a week — you'll find out when it lands!

them.zh: 小氣鬼！好啦，我去上課了，掰掰！
them.py: Xiǎoqìguǐ! Hǎo la, wǒ qù shàngkè le, bāibāi!
them.en: Meanie! Fine, I'm off to class — bye!

turns.task: Send her off: study hard — talk next time!

ans.zh: 好好上課！下次再聊，掰掰！
ans.py: Hǎohǎo shàngkè! Xiàcì zài liáo, bāibāi!
ans.en: Study hard! Talk next time — bye!

scenarios.intro: One box of Taiwan, bound for America: declare the contents, weigh the air-versus-sea trade-off, fill the form, protect the cakes.

them.zh: 您好，下一位！
them.py: Nín hǎo, xià yí wèi!
them.en: Hello, next please!

turns.task: Say you want to send this package to America.

ans.zh: 你好，我要寄這個包裹到美國。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào jì zhège bāoguǒ dào Měiguó.
ans.en: Hi — I'd like to send this package to America.

them.zh: 好的。裡面是什麼東西？有食物嗎？
them.py: Hǎo de. Lǐmiàn shì shénme dōngxi? Yǒu shíwù ma?
them.en: Sure. What's inside? Any food?

turns.task: Declare honestly: pineapple cakes, tea leaves, and small gifts.

ans.zh: 有，裡面是鳳梨酥、茶葉，還有一些小禮物。
ans.py: Yǒu, lǐmiàn shì fènglísū, cháyè, háiyǒu yìxiē xiǎo lǐwù.
ans.en: Yes — pineapple cakes, tea leaves, and some small gifts.

them.zh: 了解。空運七到十天，四百五；海運六到八個星期，一百五。
them.py: Liǎojiě. Kōngyùn qī dào shí tiān, sìbǎi wǔ; hǎiyùn liù dào bā ge xīngqí, yìbǎi wǔ.
them.en: Got it. Air: 7-10 days, 450. Sea: 6-8 weeks, 150.

turns.task: Reason it out loud: sea is cheaper, but the food would spoil — take air freight.

ans.zh: 海運比較便宜，可是食物會壞，我還是選空運好了。
ans.py: Hǎiyùn bǐjiào piányí, kěshì shíwù huì huài, wǒ háishì xuǎn kōngyùn hǎo le.
ans.en: Sea's cheaper, but the food would spoil — air freight it is.

them.zh: 好的，麻煩填這張單子：收件人、地址、內容物。
them.py: Hǎo de, máfán tián zhè zhāng dānzi: shōujiànrén, dìzhǐ, nèiróngwù.
them.en: Alright — fill in this form: recipient, address, contents.

turns.task: Take the form — and ask them to stick a fragile label on, since the cakes break easily.

ans.zh: 好。鳳梨酥容易碎，麻煩幫我貼「易碎」，謝謝。
ans.py: Hǎo. Fènglísū róngyì suì, máfán bāng wǒ tiē 'yìsuì', xièxie.
ans.en: Sure. The cakes break easily — a fragile sticker please, thanks.

them.zh: 沒問題！一共四百五。祝家人吃得開心！
them.py: Méi wèntí! Yígòng sìbǎi wǔ. Zhù jiārén chī de kāixīn!
them.en: Done! 450 total. Hope your family enjoys them!

turns.task: Pay and thank them — this box is Taiwan's flavors flying home.

ans.zh: 謝謝你！這箱是台灣的味道，要飛回家了！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ! Zhè xiāng shì Táiwān de wèidào, yào fēi huíjiā le!
ans.en: Thanks! This box is the taste of Taiwan, flying home!

scenarios.intro: Clause by clause with legal: defend what's fine, fix what's vague, and own the Monday deadline — contract Mandarin at working speed.

them.zh: Eric，合約我看完了，整體寫得不錯。
them.py: Eric, héyuē wǒ kàn wán le, zhěngtǐ xiě de búcuò.
them.en: Eric, I've been through the contract — solid overall.

turns.task: Good to hear — ask which clauses need adjusting.

ans.zh: 太好了。請問有哪些條款需要修改？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le. Qǐngwèn yǒu nǎxiē tiáokuǎn xūyào xiūgǎi?
ans.en: Great. Which clauses need revising?

them.zh: 就一條：延遲交貨的罰則太模糊，「合理賠償」是什麼意思？
them.py: Jiù yì tiáo: yánchí jiāohuò de fázé tài móhú, 'hélǐ péicháng' shì shénme yìsi?
them.en: Just one: the late-delivery penalty is too vague — what does 'reasonable compensation' even mean?

turns.task: Propose concrete numbers: per day of delay, 0.5% of the contract value, capped at 10%.

ans.zh: 那改成清楚的數字：每延遲一天，罰合約金額的千分之五，上限百分之十。
ans.py: Nà gǎi chéng qīngchǔ de shùzì: měi yánchí yì tiān, fá héyuē jīn'é de qiānfēnzhī wǔ, shàngxiàn bǎifēnzhī shí.
ans.en: Let's make it concrete: 0.5% of contract value per day of delay, capped at ten percent.

turns.keys: 千分之五上限百分之十

them.zh: 可以，這樣對雙方都公平。二十四小時回覆的承諾，你確定要寫進合約？
them.py: Kěyǐ, zhèyàng duì shuāngfāng dōu gōngpíng. Èrshísì xiǎoshí huífù de chéngnuò, nǐ quèdìng yào xiě jìn héyuē?
them.en: Works — fair to both sides. And the 24-hour response promise — sure you want it IN the contract?

turns.task: Stand by it: yes — you promised the chairman face to face, and written commitments build the long-term trust this deal is about.

ans.zh: 確定。這是我當面跟董事長承諾的，寫進去才能建立長期的信任。
ans.py: Quèdìng. Zhè shì wǒ dāngmiàn gēn dǒngshìzhǎng chéngnuò de, xiě jìnqù cáinéng jiànlì chángqí de xìnrèn.
ans.en: Certain. I promised the chairman to his face — writing it in is how long-term trust gets built.

them.zh: 有膽識，我欣賞。那修改版什麼時候要？
them.py: Yǒu dǎnshì, wǒ xīnshǎng. Nà xiūgǎi bǎn shénme shíhòu yào?
them.en: Bold — I like it. When do you need the revised version?

turns.task: Own the timeline: revised draft by Monday morning, then you email it to Mr. Wang the same day.

ans.zh: 星期一早上以前改好，我當天就寄給王先生。
ans.py: Xīngqí yī zǎoshang yǐqián gǎi hǎo, wǒ dàngtiān jiù jì gěi Wáng xiānshēng.
ans.en: Revised by Monday morning — I'll email Mr. Wang the same day.

them.zh: 沒問題。簽約那天，法務也派人陪你們去高雄。
them.py: Méi wèntí. Qiānyuē nà tiān, fǎwù yě pài rén péi nǐmen qù Gāoxióng.
them.en: Done. And on signing day, legal will send someone south with you.

turns.task: Welcome it — with legal along, everyone signs with confidence. Thank them.

ans.zh: 太好了，有法務在場，大家簽得更安心。謝謝你！
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, yǒu fǎwù zàichǎng, dàjiā qiān de gèng ānxīn. Xièxie nǐ!
ans.en: Perfect — with legal in the room, everyone signs easier. Thank you!

scenarios.en: Interview: The Generation Afraid to Have Kids
scenarios.intro: Tonight's OPI drill: diagnose the world's lowest birth rate, weigh the subsidy approach honestly, and argue the structural fix — threads from the labor-shortage and housing interviews braided into one.

them.zh: 台灣的生育率是全世界最低之一。你觀察到的原因是什麼？
them.py: Táiwān de shēngyùlǜ shì quán shìjiè zuì dī zhīyī. Nǐ guānchá dào de yuányīn shì shénme?
them.en: Taiwan's birth rate is among the world's lowest. What causes do you observe?

turns.task: Three roots, one sentence each: housing prices eat the future, wages lag the effort, working hours leave no room for family.

ans.zh: 我觀察到三個根本原因：房價吃掉了未來，薪資追不上辛苦，工時長到沒有空間給家庭。
ans.py: Wǒ guānchá dào sān ge gēnběn yuányīn: fángjià chī diào le wèilái, xīnzī zhuī bú shàng xīnkǔ, gōngshí cháng dào méiyǒu kōngjiān gěi jiātíng.
ans.en: Three roots: housing prices devour the future, wages don't match the toil, and working hours leave no room for family.

them.zh: 政府發了很多育兒補助，為什麼效果有限？
them.py: Zhèngfǔ fā le hěnduō yù'ér bǔzhù, wèishénme xiàoguǒ yǒuxiàn?
them.en: The government hands out plenty of subsidies — why the limited effect?

turns.task: Concede then reframe: subsidies ease the first year, but a child is a twenty-year decision — one-time cash can't answer a structural question.

ans.zh: 補助確實能減輕第一年的壓力，但是生小孩是二十年的決定，一次性的錢回答不了結構性的問題。
ans.py: Bǔzhù quèshí néng jiǎnqīng dì yī nián de yālì, dànshì shēng xiǎohái shì èrshí nián de juédìng, yícìxìng de qián huídá bù liǎo jiégòuxìng de wèntí.
ans.en: Subsidies genuinely ease year one — but a child is a twenty-year decision, and one-time money can't answer a structural question.

them.zh: 那你覺得什麼政策才有用？
them.py: Nà nǐ juéde shénme zhèngcè cái yǒuyòng?
them.en: So what policies would actually work?

turns.task: The package: affordable housing near jobs, real wage growth, normalized hours, and public childcare parents can trust — all four together, or none works.

ans.zh: 要一整套：買得起的住宅、真實的薪資成長、正常的工時，加上父母信得過的公共托育——四個一起做才有用，缺一個都不行。
ans.py: Yào yì zhěng tào: mǎi de qǐ de zhùzhái, zhēnshí de xīnzī chéngzhǎng, zhèngcháng de gōngshí, jiāshàng fùmǔ xìn de guò de gōnggòng tuōyù — sì ge yìqǐ zuò cái yǒuyòng, quē yíge dōu bùxíng.
ans.en: A full package: affordable housing, real wage growth, normal hours, and public childcare parents trust — all four together, or it fails.

them.zh: 少子化對你們產業有影響嗎？
them.py: Shǎozǐhuà duì nǐmen chǎnyè yǒu yǐngxiǎng ma?
them.en: Does the birthrate decline affect your industry?

turns.task: Directly: fewer graduates each year while demand explodes — the talent war from the labor-shortage era is the same story, twenty years earlier in a maternity ward.

ans.zh: 影響很直接：畢業生一年比一年少，需求卻在爆炸。缺工時代的搶人大戰，其實二十年前就在產房裡決定了。
ans.py: Yǐngxiǎng hěn zhíjiē: bìyèshēng yì nián bǐ yì nián shǎo, xūqiú què zài bàozhà. Quēgōng shídài de qiǎng rén dàzhàn, qíshí èrshí nián qián jiù zài chǎnfáng lǐ juédìng le.
ans.en: Very directly: graduates shrink yearly while demand explodes. The talent war of the labor-shortage era was decided twenty years earlier — in the maternity ward.

them.zh: 「在產房裡決定」——這句話很重。謝謝你今天的分享！
them.py: 'Zài chǎnfáng lǐ juédìng' — zhè jù huà hěn zhòng. Xièxie nǐ jīntiān de fēnxiǎng!
them.en: 'Decided in the maternity ward' — heavy words. Thank you for sharing tonight!

turns.task: Close with the human note: policy is numbers, but behind it are young people who want families and dare not — solve their fear, and the numbers follow.

ans.zh: 謝謝主持人。政策是數字，但數字後面是想成家卻不敢的年輕人——解決他們的害怕，數字自然會回來。
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén. Zhèngcè shì shùzì, dàn shùzì hòumiàn shì xiǎng chéngjiā què bù gǎn de niánqīngrén — jiějué tāmen de hàipà, shùzì zìrán huì huílái.
ans.en: Thank you. Policy is numbers — but behind the numbers are young people who want families and dare not. Solve their fear, and the numbers return on their own.

x: 我爸爸很喜歡釣魚。
Wǒ bàba hěn xǐhuān diàoyú.
My dad loves fishing.
vocab.n: Formal: 父親 fùqīn. Taiwanese kids also say 把拔 in cutesy texting.

x: 媽媽每個星期都打給我。
Māma měige xīngqí dōu dǎ gěi wǒ.
Mom calls me every week.
vocab.n: Formal: 母親 mǔqīn. The eternal first question: 吃飽了沒？

x: 我妹妹在上大學。
Wǒ mèimei zài shàng dàxué.
My little sister is in college.
vocab.n: The sibling grid: 哥哥 older bro, 姊姊 older sis, 弟弟 younger bro, 妹妹 younger sis — age baked into every word.

x: 我們週末視訊聊天。
Wǒmen zhōumò shìxùn liáotiān.
We video chat on weekends.
vocab.n: Taiwan's word; the mainland says 視頻通話. 視訊會議 = video conference — office essential.

x: 我很想念家人。
Wǒ hěn xiǎngniàn jiārén.
I really miss my family.
vocab.n: Fuller than bare 想 (我想你): 想念 carries the ongoing ache. 想念台灣的味道 works too.

vocab.e: to be at ease, not worry
x: 交給我，你放心！
Jiāo gěi wǒ, nǐ fàngxīn!
Leave it to me — don't worry!
vocab.n: Literally 'set the heart down.' 讓人放心 = reassuring; the opposite is 擔心.

x: 這張照片拍得真好。
Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn pāi de zhēn hǎo.
This photo came out great.
vocab.n: Counted with 張. 拍照 is the act; 照片 is the artifact.

x: 我們聊天聊到十二點。
Wǒmen liáotiān liáo dào shí'èr diǎn.
We chatted until midnight.
vocab.n: 聊天室 chat room; 尬聊 = awkward forced small talk (internet slang bonus).

x: 麻煩填一下這張單子。
Máfán tián yíxià zhè zhāng dānzi.
Please fill in this form.
vocab.n: The everyday word for any form or slip: 點菜單子 order slip, 掛號單 registration slip. Formal cousin: 表格.

x: 我明天把文件寄給你。
Wǒ míngtiān bǎ wénjiàn jì gěi nǐ.
I'll mail you the documents tomorrow.
vocab.n: Physical mail AND email both use 寄 in Taiwan (寄 email); digital messages use 傳.

x: 急件用空運比較保險。
Jíjiàn yòng kōngyùn bǐjiào bǎoxiǎn.
Air freight is safer for urgent shipments.
vocab.n: The 運 family: 空運 air, 海運 sea, 貨運 cargo, 運費 shipping cost — logistics in one character.

x: 請先填這張表格。
Qǐng xiān tián zhè zhāng biǎogé.
Please fill in this form first.
vocab.n: 填表/填單子/填資料 — banks, clinics, customs. Bureaucracy's favorite verb.

x: 簽名以前要看清楚條款。
Qiānmíng yǐqián yào kàn qīngchǔ tiáokuǎn.
Read the terms carefully before signing.
vocab.n: 條 = article, 款 = item. 第三條第二款 = Article 3, Paragraph 2 — how lawyers navigate.

x: 合約還在法務審查中。
Héyuē hái zài fǎwù shěnchá zhōng.
The contract is still under legal review.
vocab.n: Also government vetting: 安全審查 security review — a word your government customers use daily.

x: 這一段麻煩再修改一下。
Zhè yí duàn máfán zài xiūgǎi yíxià.
Please revise this section once more.
vocab.n: Documents, code, and laws all get 修改; 修改版 = the revised version.

x: 這件事要先問法務。
Zhè jiàn shì yào xiān wèn fǎwù.
Check with legal on this first.
vocab.n: The corporate department; a 律師 is an actual lawyer. 過法務 = clear legal review.

x: 少子化讓學校一間一間關。
Shǎozǐhuà ràng xuéxiào yì jiān yì jiān guān.
The birthrate decline is closing schools one by one.
vocab.n: Japanese-coined term adopted across East Asia. The -化 suffix = -ization: 高齡化, 數位化, 自動化.

x: 台灣正快速走向高齡化社會。
Táiwān zhèng kuàisù zǒuxiàng gāolínghuà shèhuì.
Taiwan is fast becoming an aged society.
vocab.n: 超高齡社會 = super-aged society (20%+ over 65) — Taiwan crossed that line in the news constantly.

x: 工作人口逐年減少。
Gōngzuò rénkǒu zhúnián jiǎnshǎo.
The working population shrinks year by year.
vocab.n: 人口紅利 demographic dividend, 人口老化 aging population — the statistics beat's core noun.

x: 生育率連續幾年創新低。
Shēngyùlǜ liánxù jǐ nián chuàng xīndī.
The birth rate has set record lows for years running.
vocab.n: The -率 suffix makes rates: 失業率 unemployment, 匯率 exchange rate, 成功率 success rate.

x: 三十歲還什麼都問媽媽，標準媽寶。
Sānshí suì hái shénme dōu wèn māma, biāozhǔn mābǎo.
Thirty years old and still asks mom everything — textbook mama's boy.
slang.n: Taiwan: 媽媽的寶貝 compressed. A top-tier dating-world red flag word; use with caution and comic timing.

x: 媽媽問我什麼時候結婚，我妹的神回覆救了我。
Māma wèn wǒ shénme shíhòu jiéhūn, wǒ mèi de shén huífù jiù le wǒ.
Mom asked when I'm getting married — my sister's godlike comeback saved me.
slang.n: Taiwan internet: 神 as a prefix = divinely good (神隊友's cousin). A 神回覆 wins the group chat instantly.

x: 阿母又打來問我吃飽了沒。
A-bú yòu dǎ lái wèn wǒ chībǎo le méi.
Mom called AGAIN to ask if I've eaten.
slang.n: Hokkien. 阿爸 a-pah = dad. Saying 阿母 instead of 媽媽 instantly doubles your Taiwan-localness.

slang.e: to flood feeds with kid photos
x: 他當爸爸以後，每天都在曬娃。
Tā dāng bàba yǐhòu, měitiān dōu zài shàiwá.
Since becoming a dad, it's baby photos every single day.
slang.n: Mainland internet: 曬 'to sun-dry' = to show off online. 曬恩愛 = flaunting couple pics; 曬薪水 = salary flexing.

x: 星期五下午，大家都在摸魚。
Xīngqí wǔ xiàwǔ, dàjiā dōu zài mōyú.
Friday afternoon — everyone's quietly slacking.
slang.n: Mainland slang from 渾水摸魚 (fishing in muddy waters), fluently used in Taiwan offices. The Friday national pastime.
